lead.headline: Loveland's neck lands on Friday's report
lead.deck: 1-6. Decide the tight end on Saturday's designation — Pitts locks Sunday noon, a day before Loveland plays.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Colston Loveland was added to the Bears' report with a neck injury and practised limited; ESPN lists him questionable, and Chicago designate on Saturday. He plays Monday night at Seattle — but Kyle Pitts, the only bench tight end who can cover him, kicks off Sunday at 12:00, so the cover has to be chosen before then: if Saturday says out or doubtful, start Pitts. George Pickens is questionable after three limited days, but he is on the bench and his coach expects him to play. Rashee Rice went full on Friday and is clear. Jonathan Taylor plays: Shane Steichen shut down talk of sitting him during trade talks. 44.1 banked from Thursday; 140.4 to Metcalf Gala's 122.2, 60%.
